title: Milwaukee M18 Brushless Stick Transfer Pump, Tool Only
description: Transform your fluid transfer tasks with this powerful M18 Brushless Stick Transfer Pump. This versatile bare tool is designed for efficient liquid movement across various applications. The brushless motor technology delivers reliable performance while maximizing runtime and tool life. Perfect for water transfer, equipment drainage, and general pumping needs, this stick pump offers convenient portability and ease of use. Its compact design allows access to tight spaces, while the cordless operation provides freedom of movement. Compatible with M18 batteries (sold separately), this transfer pump combines the convenience of cordless operation with professional-grade performance. Whether you're a contractor, maintenance professional, or DIY enthusiast, this pump is ready to tackle your fluid transfer challenges with consistent, dependable operation.
